title: Finite scalar lifts of compatible principal puncture sections
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth], let g lie in its maximal ideal, and let W be its punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put f:R to R/(g). For every compatible family s_n of sections of the open quotient-power thickenings [lem-sbc-finite-etale-adic-sections-transfer], each finite-level section s_n is the scalar restriction of some a in R. The scalar restriction is GammaSpecIso.inv followed by the global sections map of openThickeningMap f W n composed with W.ι. No compatibility of the chosen scalars, no completion element and no uniqueness are asserted.

source.place: Tags 0H3E (Example 20.39.3, pro-isomorphism of the two-term cones with ordinary quotients), 0BLD (degree zero), 0BK0 and 0AVY; finite-stage specialization.

proof.text: Apply the eventual scalar-image comparison to n to obtain a finite gap k, independent of the section.

Induct on k to show that the recursively composed k restrictions send s_(n+k) to s_n, using the consecutive compatibility hypothesis at n+k in the successor step. Apply the eventual image theorem to s_(n+k), then rewrite the resulting equality by this induction.

proof_origin.place: Elementary finite-stage compatibility deduction after the pro-zero cokernel comparison (Tags 0H3E, 0BK0, 0AVY).

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_principal_finite_level_lift
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (g : R) (hg : g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) R)
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) :
    let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    ∀ s : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening f W n, ⊤),
      (∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningTransition f W n).appTop
        (s (n + 1)) = s n) →
      ∀ n, ∃ a : R,
        ((ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫
          (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap f W n ≫ W.ι).appTop) a = s n
